text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Thank you very much for your 
hard work each and every day! Thanks to 
all of you, Tracen Academy continues to 
flourish and reach ever greater 
potential—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nn-no way! No being stiff and formal 
today! Let's enjoy our retreat! Cheeeers!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, an overnight retreat was held for 
the academy's staff, who were always 
extremely busy.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Umm... this is our fifth toast, 
Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"She's always been prone to getting caught 
up in the mood, but... she's on another 
level today."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Could she be sleepy, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Chairwoman, it's almost time for bed. 
Shall we head back to your room?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mm! Splendid!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Phew... It sure got quiet all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Meek managed to practice on 
her own properly... It feels like we're 
being unfair to her.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine once in a while, don't worry 
about it! Just forget about everything for 
today and let's enjoy ourselves to the 
fullest~!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, you are—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good morning! Did you manage to get 
some rest~?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...? Yes, thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, Kashimoto-san aside, Trainers 
really are full of energy, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy even after sightseeing all 
day! I've gotta follow her example~!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It was amazing just a moment ago 
too!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The other Trainers got tipsy, shouted that 
it was time for a dirt race, and ran off 
to the beach. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...At the academy, one must always act 
like a respectable adult. Just for 
tonight, I shall overlook a little."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, that is only minor. Bad rumors 
about the academy harm the students... 
Should I go warn them, just in case...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa! It's fine, we're 
all adults here! More importantly, here, 
Kashimoto-san, have a seat too!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse meee, two more medium bottles, 
please~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I'm back~. Hehe, as for the 
Chairwoman, as soon as we got to the room, 
she was fast asleep—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my...!? I believe this area is 
strictly off-limits to unauthorized 
personnel!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Gyahaa! You're back early!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Wow, time to retreat~☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hold on right there!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: What?! Th-Th-They weren't with you?!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I-I also assumed, um, that they were an 
acquaintance of Trainer Kiryuin...!
